description: For any premise set \(\Gamma\) and shared formulas \(A,B,C\), if \(C\) is stable and intuitionistic derivations prove \(\neg\neg(A\lor B)\) from \(\Gamma\), and prove \(C\) from each of \(\Gamma\cup\{A\}\) and \(\Gamma\cup\{B\}\), then an intuitionistic derivation proves \(C\) from \(\Gamma\).
